issues.description: The problem text explicitly requires using StringBuilder for the Animal name attribute to enable efficient string manipulations, but the provided solution implements the name attribute as a String. This creates a structural mismatch: students are told to use StringBuilder, yet the reference implementation (and likely any provided tests) use String. This can confuse students about the expected type for the name field and the signatures/return types of the getter/setter.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the specification and reference implementation consistent. Either update the problem statement to remove the StringBuilder requirement (accept String for the name), or change the solution (and any tests) so Animal uses a StringBuilder name field and corresponding getter/setter returning/accepting StringBuilder. Also ensure any call sites (e.g., messageOnRide()/messageOnMilk()) use the adjusted getter appropriately.
